operators.name: mish_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise Mish activation: y = x * tanh(softplus(x)) where softplus(x) = log(1 + exp(x)).
Preserves input shape, dtype, and device; output is on CUDA.
Input tensor is contiguous float32 on CUDA; no broadcasting or reduction.
No bias or other parameters involved.
Applies nn.Mish elementwise to input tensor x.
Input shape [2048, 3, 256, 256], dtype float32, device CUDA; output same shape and dtype.
Returns a tensor equal to x * tanh(softplus(x)) elementwise.
